test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held on: 02 March 2023)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

My father give up / smoking when / I was twelve / years old.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **My father give up.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb** "give up" **needs to be in the past tense, as the action has already happened. (the action happened when the speaker was twelve years old)
 
• The** various verb forms** of **"give" **are:
 
 
• Infinitive: **to give**
 
• Present tense: **give(s)**
 
• Past tense:** gave**
 
• Present participle: **giving**
 
• Past participle: **given**
 
 
 
• Therefore, it should be **"gave up" i**nstead of** "give up".** 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

**Correct Sentence:__ ***My father __**gave up**__ smoking when I was twelve years old.*
